title: Static triage: which proposed grader attacks would survive TQ-2's hardening recipe

model_calls.note: No omp -p call, no hosted or local model inference. Every number is a deterministic regex count over text files.

executions.note: The proposed attack scripts were read as text only. TQ-2's matrix was read from its published receipt, not re-run.

what_ran: This writes receipts/rule-table.json and receipts/seeker-predictions.json; it reads text files and emits JSON. Nothing else was executed.

inputs_read.raw/TQ-2/receipts/attack-matrix.json: published TQ-2 matrix (labels: first neutralising layer)
inputs_read.raw/TQ-2/receipts/hardened-test-sh-templ: layer definitions (L1 reset set, L2 isolation, L3 report gate, L4 clean tree)
inputs_read.ds-tq-2 worktree toy/attacks/*: the 10 TQ-2 attack payloads (text), read to validate the rule; none executed
inputs_read.raw/DT-5b/receipts/detector-results.json: D1/D1b/D2 hits on the SK-5 run population

not_read: any held-out or cross-test key path
HackBench or any gated benchmark data

prediction_inputs: TQ-2 attack payload text and target paths
